issue.title: Listen-card Pandoc test pins ampersand escaping in href URI
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-4q.4 note #2; independently reproduced twice on clean bob-cli ade4b8a during landing. Exact command: cargo test --lib native::highlights_ref::create::tests::listen_filter_renders_card_and_encoded_play_link -- --exact --test-threads=1. Pandoc 3.1.11.1 succeeds and outputs a BobListenCard and BobListenPlay, but the URI contains Research\%20Notes&file=lib\%2Fchat\%2Freport.mp3; create.rs:1172-1175 requires Research\%20Notes\&file=... and fails. git blame pins the unchanged assertion to 99293a5 (2026-10-05), before both inbox epic bob-cli-4q and active highlights epic bob-cli-4s. Narrow root cause of the failing assertion is the exact escaping expectation in the Pandoc-generated href URI. Confirm correct TeX/link behavior, then make this test check URI preservation across supported Pandoc output rather than pinning incidental escaping, or fix the renderer if the produced URI is incorrect. Preserve percent encoding, Play/card structure, and narration-link removal. Do not merely drop URI coverage. Two isolated runs failed identically; no known flake. bob-cli-4s may edit the same create.rs but did not cause this defect.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Two exact isolated serial runs on unchanged ade4b8a fail identically at create.rs:1172 because Pandoc 3.1.11.1 emits an unescaped ampersand in the href URI while the assertion requires a backslash escape.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-4q.4 reported this unchanged Rust test failure; two independent serial reproductions confirm a pre-existing failure outside inbox-routing scope.
